capabilities: Show up to five similar existing notes in a sidebar panel while a new note is being written
Open an existing note side by side with the one being written
Append the new note's body into the existing note under a heading
Redirect a duplicate by adding its title as an alias, replacing its body with a link, and offering to trash it
Match notes by meaning with an optional locally installed embedding engine (Pro)
disambiguation: Not a patent or legal research tool; "prior art" here means existing notes in your own vault.
extras: Freemium: free tier covers title/alias/heading matching and all merge actions; the $29 Second Read Pro key (shared across five add-ons by the same author) unlocks semantic matching, which requires downloading a local engine binary verified by SHA-256 before it runs. The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author wanted the Stack Overflow "questions that may already have your answer" pattern applied to the vault, so duplicates are caught before they are written.
problem: Obsidian gives no warning when a new note duplicates an existing one, and deleting a duplicate breaks every link pointing at it.
summary: Duplicate catcher that shows similar existing notes while you write a new one and merges them without breaking inbound links.
